key.name: map
key.description: Which module's tone map program changes resolve against, as ts::ToneMap: 1 SC-55, 2 SC-88, 3 SC-88Pro, 4 SC-8820, 119 XG.

key.name: ports
key.description: 1, 2 or 4, giving 16, 32 or 64 parts. The module has two.

key.name: extended-interpolation
key.description: The wide band-limiting resampler, and with it the removal of the module's pitch increment ceiling. On is the engine's own default and the one place it knowingly departs from SCCore.dll; off reproduces the module exactly, aliasing and stalled glides included.

key.name: flush-before-sysex
key.description: Start a fresh input-queue window at every SysEx message, so a bulk dump larger than one control tick arrives whole. The module takes 2,048 packets per tick and silently discards the rest, and off reproduces that; on plays a file as written rather than as the hardware receives it, which is not what a render compared against SCCore.dll wants.

key.name: output-gain
key.summary: Linear gain on the finished mix

key.name: latency-ms
key.summary: How far ahead of the device to render
key.description: Lower answers a keyboard sooner; raise it if you hear dropouts. Changing it never reallocates the ring, so it is safe to drag while playing.

key.name: looping
key.summary: Repeat at the file's own loop points

key.name: midi-auto-connect
key.summary: Subscribe to every readable ALSA sequencer port
key.description: Convenient with one keyboard attached, and wrong on a machine running a sequencer, where it would echo everything back into the synth.

key.name: rom-verified
key.summary: Whether the stored ROM has passed a full hash
key.description: Once true, later launches check only size and PE timestamp, which is all a file already verified once needs.
